description: KaiCalls connects your AI to your business phone system. Ask it to read your recent calls and transcripts, check leads, voicemails, texts, campaigns, and call analytics, and place outbound calls through your own KaiCalls agent. Everything is scoped to your own account, so the assistant works with your real phone activity instead of a closed dashboard. The read tools answer questions like who called today, what did they want, and which leads are hot; the single action tool can have your own agent call a lead back when you ask it to.
